Werken bij Sirva biedt je de kans om deel uit te maken van een wereldwijd netwerk van professionals. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en ondersteunen je met flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden, opleidingsmogelijkheden en internationale carrièrekansen.

Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden
Internationale carrièrekansen

title: Person In Charge (PIC)-Anchorage
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

As a primary contact for Safeway customers, the Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

JOB DUTIES:

Safeway PIC employees are generally responsible for completing the following job duties:

  1. Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

  2. Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.

  3. Maintains high level of familiarity with company policies and procedures.

  4. Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

  5. Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

  6. Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.

  7. Assists other cashiers with computer, register, and scanner problems.

  8. Responsible for performing basic office functions to assist customers and personnel.

  9. Operates electronically scanning cash register to total customers’ final bill.

  10. Receive payment for customer purchase and count back correct change.

  11. Bag groceries in paper, canvas, or plastic bags. Lift bags into grocery cart. Offer customer assistance with carry out, and perform that task if a Courtesy Clerk is not available.

  12. May be responsible for completing close of day function in the office.

  13. May be responsible for counting out of stock product.

  14. May count tills when other cashier-checkers leave.

  15. Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Ability to follow company customer service procedures. Demonstrated prior customer service skills or related experience.

  2. Ability to interact with customers and co-workers.

  3. Ability to understand and follow instructions.

All store employees during the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.

title: Senior Transit Project Manager
description:
At Burnside the difference is our people. Our employees are our greatest asset and by encouraging continuous growth and supporting personal development our organization benefits from the increased skill and leadership capacity that results.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Transit Group, responsible for delivering complex public-sector transit and rail infrastructure projects. This role is well suited to an experienced professional who thrives in multi-disciplinary environments, builds trusted client relationships, and guides teams through the full project lifecycle — from early planning through construction and commissioning.

Our Transit Group is actively involved in a wide range of initiatives, including new and redeveloped transit stations, rail corridor improvements, parking expansions, environmental assessments, large-scale design-build opportunities, and other complex transit programs. Project Managers with experience across broader municipal infrastructure projects are also encouraged to apply.

You will work collaboratively with Project Managers and Engineers under the direction of the Senior Vice President – Transit, contributing to strategic growth while ensuring consistent, high-quality project delivery.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • Provide project and client management for transit-related public sector assignments.
  • Lead and coordinate proposal preparation, including technical approach, resourcing, and fee development.
  • Develop, monitor, and control project budgets, schedules, and risk registers.
  • Facilitate and manage approvals with commenting agencies and stakeholders.
  • Direct and coordinate the preparation of design drawings and technical documentation for transit facilities and infrastructure.
  • Review and evaluate design submissions, cost estimates, and construction schedules from contractors, utilities, public agencies, and designers.
  • Ensure seamless project delivery across design, tender, and construction phases.
  • Support business development initiatives, helping grow the Transit practice and strengthen key client relationships.
  • Lead, mentor, and support staff through performance planning, coaching, and development.

Experience & Professional Credentials

  • 15+ years of experience delivering transit and/or rail infrastructure projects.
  • A diverse civil engineering background with demonstrated leadership on transit-related assignments.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) for a minimum of 7 years.
  • PMP designation is an asset (or willingness/ability to obtain).
  • Experience working across infrastructure delivery models, including:
    • Design-Bid-Build (DBB)
    • Design-Build (DB)
    • P3 / AFP delivery models
  • Experience leading or supporting Municipal Class Environmental Assessments, Transit Project Assessment Process, or Rail Project Assessments is considered an asset.

Technical & Leadership Strengths

  • Strong multi-disciplinary knowledge of transit infrastructure, with the ability to provide strategic oversight.
  • Technical expertise in light rail, commuter or passenger rail systems, and/or BRT (Bus Rapid Transit), including interactions with municipal infrastructure and roadways.
  • Proven ability to lead complex teams, coordinate sub-consultants, and manage procurement, construction, and commissioning.

description:

title: Person In Charge (PIC)-Juneau
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

As a primary contact for Safeway customers, the Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

JOB DUTIES:

Safeway PIC employees are generally responsible for completing the following job duties:

  1. Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

  2. Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.

  3. Maintains high level of familiarity with company policies and procedures.

  4. Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

  5. Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

  6. Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.

  7. Assists other cashiers with computer, register, and scanner problems.

  8. Responsible for performing basic office functions to assist customers and personnel.

  9. Operates electronically scanning cash register to total customers’ final bill.

  10. Receive payment for customer purchase and count back correct change.

  11. Bag groceries in paper, canvas, or plastic bags. Lift bags into grocery cart. Offer customer assistance with carry out, and perform that task if a Courtesy Clerk is not available.

  12. May be responsible for completing close of day function in the office.

  13. May be responsible for counting out of stock product.

  14. May count tills when other cashier-checkers leave.

  15. Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Ability to follow company customer service procedures. Demonstrated prior customer service skills or related experience.

  2. Ability to interact with customers and co-workers.

  3. Ability to understand and follow instructions.

  4. Knowledge of all positions within the store.

  5. Ability to work independently.

  6. Desired: Prior experience as a clerk or manager.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

All store employees during the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.

PERMITS/LICENSES:

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.


Job Title: Person In Charge (PIC)

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

%Inside: 100% %Outside: Rare Temperature Extremes: N/A

Chemicals: Seldom (mild detergents or glass cleaner)

MACHINES, TOOLS, AND EQUIPMENT:

six-wheeled cart, grocery cart, box cutter, pens and pencils, spray bottle, rags, mops, broom, telephone/intercom, cash register, credit card scanner, computer, pallet jack, bailer

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Constant (over 70% of the time)

Frequent (30-70%)

Occasional (10-30%)

Seldom (1-10%)

Lifting:

Constantly lifts 1-10 lbs. Frequently lifts 11-20 lbs. Seldom lifts 21-35 lbs.

Carrying:

Occasionally carries 1-10 lbs. Seldom carries 11-50 lbs.

Pushing/Pulling:

Constantly pushes/pulls 1-10 lbs. Occasionally pushes/pulls 11-20 lbs.

Reaching:

Constant knee to shoulder reaching. Seldom overhead and at or above shoulder level reaching.

Standing:

Constant standing while on job. Sitting allowed on breaks.

Walking:

Frequent walking while on job.

Climb/Balance:

Seldom. May use step stool while stocking/facing product on high shelves.

Trunk Functions:

Frequent neck rotation and bending of head. Occasional bending/stooping, twisting, crouching, and squatting. Seldom kneeling.

Upper Extremity:

Constant handling/grasping and repetitive motion while checking, facing, and replacing stock. Frequent fine finger manipulation.

Vision:

Use of peripheral vision and depth perception to move around store and push carts in aisles. Near vision used to operate scanner, make change, and troubleshoot equipment.

Hearing:

To converse with customers, provide service, and receive questions from employees and customers. Answer pages and telephone.

Speech:

To respond to customers and employees and use intercom/telephone.

Safeway will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities who can meet overall job requirements.

title: Quality Compliance & Document Control Specialist
description:
Quality Compliance & Document Control Specialist

Location: Escondido, CA - Onsite

Reports To: Quality Manager

Pay Range: $75-95,000

Position Summary

ARCH Medical Solutions is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Quality Compliance & Document Control Specialist to support the maintenance, effectiveness, and compliance of our Quality Management System (QMS). This role combines responsibility for document control, training administration, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, quality records management, and continuous improvement initiatives within a precision machining environment serving the medical device industry.

The ideal candidate will have experience with ISO 13485, document control processes, quality systems administration, internal audits, and regulatory compliance. This individual will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure quality documentation remains accurate, current, and compliant with customer and regulatory requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 13485, FDA regulations, customer requirements, and company standards.
  • Manage QMS documentation, procedures, forms, policies, and records to ensure current revision status and availability.
  • Support external customer audits, surveillance audits, recertification audits, and regulatory inspections.
  • Coordinate and support the Internal Audit Program.
  • Assist with CAPA, customer complaint investigations, NCMRs, and corrective action activities.
  • Perform quality data analysis and trend reporting related to customer complaints, scrap, quality metrics, and process performance.
  • Support development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct QMS-related training and maintain training compliance records.
  • Serve as a resource regarding quality policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Document Control & Records Management

  • Maintain control of all quality system documentation and related records.
  • Ensure procedures, work instructions, SOPs, forms, and engineering documents are properly reviewed, approved, distributed, and archived.
  • Manage document revision history and associated document control logs.
  • Process Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and track implementation activities.
  • Create and update inspection forms, method sheets, and balloon/bubble drawings.
  • Maintain Device History Records (DHRs) and quality records in accordance with customer and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage approved supplier documentation and supplier quality agreements.
  • Facilitate employee training on new or revised procedures and ensure training records are maintained.
  • Provide administrative support including scanning, filing, labeling, printing, and record retention activities.

Compliance & Cross-Functional Support

  • Assist with contract and customer requirement reviews to ensure compliance.
  • Monitor and maintain quality-related KPI data and reporting.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to maintain training matrices and onboarding documentation.
  • Support ERP system data entry and maintenance related to quality and documentation activities.
  • Interface with customers and suppliers regarding quality documentation and compliance matters.
  • Participate in root cause investigations and quality improvement projects.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree in a technical, quality, engineering, or related field with 3+ years of relevant experience; or
  • Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related discipline preferred; or

Equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience in Quality Systems, Document Control, or Regulatory Compliance within a regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Experience supporting ISO 13485 quality systems
  • Experience with medical device manufacturing preferred.
  • Experience with ERP systems, document management systems, and electronic quality records preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA Quality System Regulations.
  • Strong understanding of document control processes and best practices.
  • Experience conducting internal audits and supporting external audits.
  • Knowledge of CAPA, complaint handling, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and document management systems.
  • Excellent written communication and technical editing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Certifications

  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
  • ISO 13485 Internal Auditor Certification

Why Join ARCH Medical Solutions?

  • Play a critical role in maintaining compliance and quality excellence.
  • Contribute directly to products used in life-changing medical devices.
  • Work with a collaborative team focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a growing medical manufacturing organization.

Additional Notes ARCH Global Precision is an Equal Opportunity Employee and wholeheartedly supports diversity in the workplace as a basic premise for business success. All employees of ARCH Global Precision are employed on an at-will basis. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. title: Person In Charge Portland Oregon
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
As a primary contact for Safeway customers, the Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.
JOB DUTIES:
Safeway PIC employees are generally responsible for completing the following job duties:
1. Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.
2. Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.
3. Maintains high level of familiarity with company policies and procedures.
4. Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.
5. Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.
6. Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.
7. Assists other cashiers with computer, register, and scanner problems.
8. Responsible for performing basic office functions to assist customers and personnel.
9. Operates electronically scanning cash register to total customers’ final bill.
10. Receive payment for customer purchase and count back correct change.
11. Bag groceries in paper, canvas, or plastic bags. Lift bags into grocery cart. Offer customer

assistance with carry out, and perform that task if a Courtesy Clerk is not available.
1. May be responsible for completing close of day function in the office.
2. May be responsible for counting out of stock product.
3. May count tills when other cashier-checkers leave.
4. Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:
1. Ability to follow company customer service procedures. Demonstrated prior customer service skills or related experience.
2. Ability to interact with customers and co-workers.
3. Ability to understand and follow instructions.
4. Knowledge of all positions within the store.
5. Ability to work independently.
6. Desired: Prior experience as a clerk or manager.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
All store employees during the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.
PERMITS/LICENSES:
Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.
WORK ENVIRONMENT:
%Inside: 100% %Outside: Rare Temperature Extremes: N/A
Chemicals: Seldom (mild detergents or glass cleaner)
MACHINES, TOOLS, AND EQUIPMENT:
six-wheeled cart, grocery cart, box cutter, pens and pencils, spray bottle, rags, mops, broom,
telephone/intercom, cash register, credit card scanner, computer, pallet jack, bailer
PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Constant (over 70% of the time)
Frequent (30-70%)
Occasional (10-30%)
Seldom (1-10%)
Lifting:
Constantly lifts 1-10 lbs. Frequently lifts 11-20 lbs. Seldom lifts 21-35 lbs.
Carrying:
Occasionally carries 1-10 lbs. Seldom carries 11-50 lbs.
Pushing/Pulling:
Constantly pushes/pulls 1-10 lbs. Occasionally pushes/pulls 11-20 lbs.
Reaching:
Constant knee to shoulder reaching. Seldom overhead and at or above shoulder level reaching.
Standing:
Constant standing while on job. Sitting allowed on breaks.
Walking:
Frequent walking while on job.
Climb/Balance:
Seldom. May use step stool while stocking/facing product on high shelves.
Trunk Functions:
Frequent neck rotation and bending of head. Occasional bending/stooping, twisting, crouching, and squatting. Seldom kneeling.
Upper Extremity:
Constant handling/grasping and repetitive motion while checking, facing, and replacing stock. Frequent fine finger manipulation.

Use of peripheral vision and depth perception to move around store and push carts in aisles. Near vision used to operate scanner, make change, and troubleshoot equipment.
Hearing:
To converse with customers, provide service, and receive questions from employees and customers. Answer pages and telephone.

To respond to customers and employees and use intercom/telephone.

title: CAD/Civil 3D Designer
description:
R.J. Burnside & Associates Limited (Burnside) and Neegan Burnside Ltd. (Neegan) are expanding our team in conjunction with the recent opening of the Thunder Bay office, and we’re looking for a CAD / Civil 3D Designer to help us deliver exceptional infrastructure solutions.

At Burnside, the difference is our people. We foster a welcoming and collaborative culture where you'll thrive in a connected environment that champions mentorship and career development supported by colleagues across the organization. Our teams work with public, Indigenous, and private sector clients on diverse range of civil infrastructure projects including land development, municipal roadways, linear infrastructure, drainage and hydrology, water/wastewater systems, solid waste, and stormwater management.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be a key contributor to our engineering design team, turning concepts into accurate, buildable designs that support land development, water/wastewater, drainage, municipal infrastructure and First Nation projects. You’ll help our projects move from vision to reality – on time, on budget, and with precision that earns client trust.

· Produce complete, accurate, and well-organized drawings – plans, profiles, grading layouts, and details – that meet client and regulatory standards the first time

· Build and refine complex 3D models (solid, surface, and mesh) that improve design accuracy and help engineers make better decisions

· Use hydrology and stormwater design tools to model catchments, optimize flow paths and integrate stormwater systems seamlessly into site designs

· Design roadway corridors and underground pipe networks that met functionality, safety, and constructability targets.

· Coordinate inputs from internal teams and external sub consultants to produce cohesive, high-quality drawing sets on schedule.

· Assist with design calculations, quantity take-offs, and field coordination to keep projects moving smoothly from concept to construction.

· Support engineers and project managers by addressing design changes or contractor inquiries quickly and accurately

What You Bring

· Diploma in Civil/Environmental/Construction Management or Computer Drafting (AutoCAD/Civil 3D), or equivalent experience.

· Minimum 2 years of experience using AutoCAD and Civil 3D. 5+ years of experience is preferred.

· Strong design skills and a passion for precision and creativity.

· Excellent time management and organizational skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint) and PDF editing tools.

· Effective communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

· High attention to detail and commitment to standards.

· Experience with municipal infrastructure design is an asset.

What Success Looks Like

· You consistently produce accurate, high-quality drawings that meet project requirements.

· You collaborate effectively across teams and disciplines to ensure smooth project delivery.

· You respond quickly and professionally to field inquiries and design adjustments.

· You contribute to a positive team culture and demonstrate initiative in learning and growth.

· You help us exceed client expectations through your technical expertise and dedication.

This is your chance to kickstart your career by working on meaningful projects that impact communities. At Burnside, we prioritize mentorship and foster an environment where you can learn, grow, and thrive. You’ll join a team that values innovation, teamwork, and a passion for civil engineering.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

· Contributing to the growth and development of a new office in Thunder Bay.

· Meaningful, community-focused projects across the North and West Region.

· Supportive environment where collaboration and knowledge-sharing are encouraged.

· Opportunities to work on a variety of project types that expand your skills and experience.

· Flexibility to apply both your technical field expertise and civil design knowledge in a balanced role.

Salary Range: $65,000 - $85,000

The final compensation offered will be based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and market conditions.

Position Type: New Position

Why Choose the Burnside Group of Companies?

The Burnside Group of Companies includes R.J. Burnside & Associates Limited with a focus on municipal, public agencies and private sector clients; Neegan Burnside Ltd. with a focus on Indigenous communities and sector clients; and Well Initiatives Limited, a full-service water well contractor.

Depending on your experience, background, and interest you will be part of a sector-based team that is the best fit for your career. As a Burnside employee, you will become part of a supportive group of colleagues across the organization that work together to provide value and service to our clients, while extending care to each other. We know that our employees are our greatest asset, and thus we strive to provide a positive work/life balance.

As a proud Canadian owned, operated and led company for over 50 years, Burnside has built a great reputation both internally with their staff and externally with their clients, as an established leader in quality engineering, environmental, project management and consulting services. Becoming part of the Burnside team opens the door to a wide range of career development, advancement, mentorship and collaboration opportunities across our 12 office locations.

We offer a wide variety of opportunities for our staff, geared to your level of independence and interests. As an agile firm willing to consider a multitude of opportunities as presented by our long-term client base, and in a number of emerging disciplines, we are willing to work with you to set a meaningful career path.

We offer:

· A collaborative culture where friendship, honesty and respect are part of our core values and practices

· Flexible working hours and office locations, including hybrid working opportunities

· A competitive compensation and benefits package

· RSP company matching plan

· Career growth and professional development opportunities

· Potential for performance-driven bonusing

· Active social committees

· A welcoming, positive, and inclusive work environment

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to valuing diversity in the workplace and we welcome resumes from all qualified candidates. Burnside will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the entire recruitment, assessment, and selection process, as required. If you are a person with a disability and require an accommodation during these processes, please contact our Human Resources department.

R.J. Burnside and Associates Limited and Neegan Burnside Ltd. Company Profiles

Founded in 1970, R.J. Burnside & Associates Limited is a growing values-driven employee-owned multidiscipline Canadian engineering and environmental consulting firm with over 450 staff. Our consistent commitment to investing in technological advancements and training, in addition to encouraging and promoting professional development, has enabled our firm to meet our ongoing and stated goal of continual improvement.

Founded in 1999, Neegan Burnside Ltd. is a majority-Indigenous owned firm committed to working with Indigenous (First Nation, Metis and Inuit) communities, agencies and industries to meet their infrastructure, development and economic goals while remaining sensitive to culture, values and beliefs. We have completed over 1,500 projects for more than 300 Indigenous communities and agencies throughout North America, many of them repeat clients with whom we work to develop long term and meaningful relationships. We endeavor to provide opportunities with our organization for Indigenous staff, as well as for community members in the projects we deliver.

Our Companies are uniquely integrated, allowing us to coordinate and access resources across both firms. As a result, we offer our clients expertise in many technical disciplines including but not limited to water and wastewater, transportation planning and design, land development, stormwater management, bridges and culverts, building engineering and sciences, municipal drainage, municipal advisory services, environmental planning and ecology, hydrogeology, air and noise, asset management, solid waste, landscape architecture and well drilling & diagnostics.

Together, we actively seek to develop relationships with a broad and diversified client base in the Public, Private and Indigenous sectors. We work on a variety of projects throughout Canada, with 11 office locations in Ontario and one in Manitoba.

We look forward to considering you as a part of our team!

title: Senior Data Platform Developer
description:
Your role as Senior Data Platform Developer

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Developer that is excited to design, build, and maintain our modern data platform. In this role, you will define and implement engineering best practices across the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to consumption. The goal of the team is to build a stable and scalable platform that empowers power users across the organization to build data products and accelerate time from data to insights.

Additionally, this role would partner with data and analytics related functions across Product, Sales, Ops, Finance and other teams to onboard power users into a self serve model. The team also owns relationship with relevant technology vendors and identifies opportunities to improve vendor product.

What you'll be doing

  • Data Ingestion & Orchestration: Design scalable ingestion frameworks for batch and streaming data. This can be standard SaaS sources, API end points, internal DB’s or our own event system. Orchestrate robust and resilient data pipelines utilizing Airflow (with opportunity to evaluate/implement workflows with Temporal).
  • Data Modelling & Semantic Layer Development: Define and enforce data modelling standards — including dimensional modelling, semantic layer development and streaming analytics. Enable software and analytics engineers to author their own transformations to production-grade standards.
  • Data Quality & Observability: Embed data validation, testing, and observability into every stage of the pipeline — from ingestion through transformation to consumption. Define testing standards for dbt models, set up monitoring and alerting to ensure data products fail loudly and actionably rather than silently.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering Workflows: Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to accelerate repetitive data product development lifecycle and ensure AI agents have accurate context and sufficient guardrails for analytics.
  • CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code: Provision, manage, and scale infrastructure using Terraform. Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI for automated testing, PR checks, validation, and deployment.
  • Data Storage & Access Control: Optimize our Snowflake warehouse for performance and cost efficiency. Implement granular Access Management, column-level masking, and strict data governance policies.
  • BI Tool Ownership: Own Evidence as a deployed tool — infrastructure, hosting, Snowflake connectivity, upgrades, and CI/CD. Enable teams to build and deploy their own data products on it.
  • Shared Technical Leadership: Partner with our developers sharing context, translating ambiguous requirements into clear architecture, aligning on technical decisions collaboratively, and building on each other's work.
  • Non-Technical User Enablement: Guide software and analytics developers on adopting production-grade standards; create documentation and tooling that makes adherence the path of least resistance. Train and up skill data power users so they can independently build, deploy, and maintain data products.
  • Own the full lifecycle. Operate in a full DevOps model — development, testing, operations, observability and support for the systems you build. Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions to ensure high-quality of team output.

We'd love to hear from you if you have

  • 3+ years of experience in building production data systems, with deep expertise in large-volume data pipelines, databases and real-time events.
  • Strong experience with data warehouse modelling, performance optimization and semantic layer development. Ability to design, optimize and provide guidance on building scalable data products.
  • Strong background with Snowflake and dbt.
  • Proficiency with Apache Airflow for workflow management and building resilient pipelines.
  • Experience synchronizing data from multiple data sources such as SaaS, Cloud DB’s, APIs and event streams.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong software engineering skills in Python.
  • Experience embedding data validation, data observability and idempotent design into deployment pipelines. Familiarity with tools like Datadog or Elementary or Soda.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate repetitive data workflows such as model and semantic layer development, versioning and deprecation.
  • Hands-on experience setting up continuous integration and deployment workflows using CircleCI or GitHub Actions for data repositories.
  • Proven track record managing cloud resources and environments using Terraform.
  • You take pride in what your team accomplishes, not just your individual output, and communicate with clarity and openness.
  • The ability to clearly articulate technical designs, project status, and risk to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with stateful, distributed workflow orchestration engines like Temporal.
  • Experience in guiding event emission teams on best practices to support building data products.
  • Experience designing AI workflows to simplify data product development lifecycle.
  • Experience with data governance frameworks and data catalogs that keep large-scale data assets discoverable.
  • Experience with code-first BI platforms (e.g., Evidence, Looker/LookML).



At Dialogue, your well-being is our priority


Taking care of others also means taking care of our team! Depending on your role and employment status, you could have access to the following benefits:

  • Access to the Dialogue app and virtual mental health support for you and your family
  • Fully funded insurance, a health spending account, dental coverage, and fitness reimbursement
  • 4 weeks vacation, 9 wellness days, and 1 volunteer day
  • Hybrid work: 3 days/week in our Montreal or Toronto offices, excluding remote roles
  • Work abroad up to 4 weeks/year
  • Incentive plans, referral bonuses & RRSP matching
  • Learning via Coursera, external training budget & mentorship
  • Optional parental leave top-up

The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for this role. At Dialogue, where a candidate's offer lands within the range is determined by relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and qualifications.

title: Breakfast Attendant
description:
Homewood Suites by Hilton Little Rock Downtown

SECTION ONE: MCR Universal Role Standards

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CLEANLINESS and FRIENDLINESS!
The MCR standard is to provide clean, friendly, well-organized and safe hotels for our guests.

AREAS OF EXCELLENCE

Happy Guests
Spotless Cleanliness
Product Consistency & Quality
Teamwork

Duties and Expectations
1. Happy Guests

Guest Relations: Greet guests happily upon arrival and throughout their stay with a smile.
Name Use: Use the guests’ names whenever possible, ensuring they feel properly welcomed.
Guest Satisfaction: All Team Members work together to contribute to great guest satisfaction scores.
Recovery: Ability to handle challenging guest situations with hospitality and a sense of urgency.
Hotel Knowledge: Strong knowledge of all features of the hotel facility and amenities.
Events: Awareness and support for all groups and events at the hotel.
Technology: Understanding of relevant technology for each role.
Phone Etiquette: Answer all incoming calls with friendly service using the approved greeting.

2. Spotless Cleanliness

Sparkling Clean Workspaces: All areas, both front and back of the house, should be kept clean and well-organized.
Pitching In: Cleanliness is a team effort! Everyone may expect to pitch in to clean guest rooms and public spaces as needed, to ensure the hotel is well-organized and safe.
Hospitality While Cleaning: Always greet every guest happily with a smile, by name if possible, while cleaning.

3. Product Consistency & Quality

Checklists to 100% Accuracy: All operational checklists are completed accurately and at the designated times, every shift.
Shift Handover Reports: Handover reports must be accurate and on time, for effective shift-to-shift communication.
Flawless Uniform: All Team Members must wear a clean, approved uniform and be well-groomed per the Team Member Handbook, while wearing a nametag and smiling at all times.

4. Teamwork

Communication: Communication between Team Members should be clear, honest, and professional.
Can Do Attitude: Willing to stretch beyond traditional role to meet the needs of the business and MCR’s guests.
Collaboration: All Team Members at all levels must be committed to working together to create a welcoming environment for guests and an effective, positive workplace.

SECTION TWO: Breakfast Attendant, Role Specific Duties and Expectations

Other Duties and Responsibilities

Table Manicure: Breakfast room tables should be cleared and properly sanitized after each guest departure and prepared for the next arriving guest.
Consistent Set-up: Breakfast buffet area should be set each morning according to specified requirement by each hotel, or brand directive.
Kitchen Checklist: The kitchen should be fully cleaned in accordance with the checklist provided each day upon completion of the breakfast period.
Food Safety: All food safety measures should be followed daily in accordance with local health codes, per the approved breakfast standards checklist.
Buffet Management: Buffet area should be kept well stocked and clean until the end of the breakfast period.

SECTION THREE: Success Metrics

Happy Guests

Management Performance Ratings
Guest Satisfaction Scores/Intent to Return

Spotless Cleanliness

GM/AGM Spot Checks
Leadership Walk-throughs (RVP, etc.)
Guest Ratings/Reviews

Product Consistency & Quality

Checklist Tracking
Management Performance Ratings
Guest Ratings

Teamwork

Management Performance Ratings

Experience in a hospitality, service, consumer-facing franchise or related field preferred.
Can-Do Attitude: Must have a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Ability to Follow Guidelines: Must be able to understand and follow established guidelines and procedures.
Handle Pace and Pressure: Must work well in stressful, high-pressure situations.
Listening, Conflict Resolution: Must be effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying, and resolving the concerns and issues raised by co-workers and guests.
Communication Skills: Must be able to convey information and ideas clearly.
Hospitality and Guest Service: Must have a desire to serve all guests.
Age Requirement: Must be 18 years of age or older to perform this job.
Schedule and Travel: Must be willing to work a varied schedule that may include evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays based upon the demands of the hotel.
Clock-in/Out: Arrive and clock in on time for every shift worked and clock out at the scheduled shift ending time, unless otherwise directed by your immediate supervisor. Never work while off the clock.
Breaks: Clock in/out for breaks at the designated time on your schedule.
Call Outs: Provide sufficient notice as directed by your supervisor when calling out for a scheduled shift.

Physical Working Demands & Working Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

title: Market Intelligence - Strategic Insights Consultant - Remote
description:
About us

Infomineo is a pioneering global AI-enhanced research company that transforms how businesses access, analyze, and act on critical intelligence. We’ve evolved from traditional business research outsourcing to become the strategic partner that combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep human expertise. We offer 3 services to our global clients (leading consulting companies, Fortune 500 companies, and government entities): AI and Data Advisory, Next-Gen Insights and Resource Scaling. This is made possible by relying on 3 pillars of excellence:

  1. 350+ industry experts spread across 5 offices (Cairo, Casablanca, Mexico City, Dubai, Barcelona).
  2. Our proprietary AI orchestrator.
  3. Extensive knowledge assets combining 500,000+ delivered case studies and database subscriptions.

Ready to build the next chapter of AI-driven insights with us?

About this role:

The Strategic Insights Consultant (Defense & Security) sits at the critical intersection of defense research and strategic decision-making. As a key member of Infomineo’s team, you will transform comprehensive defense, aerospace, and security research findings into compelling, actionable narratives that address clients’ most pressing business and operational challenges. This role is ideal for a professional with experience in the Defense sector focusing on strategy. It is also a good fit for professionals with experience at top-tier consulting firms (preferably MBB or Tier 1) who thrive on synthesizing defense market trends, evaluating defense technologies and supply chains, crafting clear business cases, and communicating insights with impact.

What you will do:

  • Insight Synthesis & Analysis: Translate complex defense industry, procurement, and market research outputs into clear, concise insights that align with client objectives.
  • Defense Domain Expertise: Analyze trends across defense technology, military procurement, aerospace, and national security dynamics to inform client strategies.
  • Storytelling: Develop compelling narratives and presentations that effectively communicate the 'so-what' of defense research findings to executive clients.
  • Strategic Recommendations: Provide actionable, data-driven recommendations that help clients navigate market entry, capability planning, or competitive positioning in the defense sector.
  • Collaboration: Partner with internal research teams to ensure insights are technically accurate, thorough, and strategically focused.
  • Client Engagement: Interact directly with defense contractors, government vendors, and strategy consulting clients to understand their needs, refine deliverables, and provide strategic guidance.
  • Knowledge Development: Contribute to internal best practices for synthesizing defense intelligence and creating impactful business cases.

Who you are

  • Experience: 10 years of experience in Defense or at a top-tier consulting firm (MBB or Tier 1 preferred) with a proven track record of delivering strategic insights and client recommendations in defense, aerospace, national security, or related sectors.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, International Relations, Strategic Studies, or a related field (MBA or advanced degree is a plus).
  • Skills:
    • Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and domain-specific research skills.
    • Strong storytelling and presentation capabilities with advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and visualization tools.
    • Ability to distill complex defense data, procurement cycles, and market dynamics into actionable insights.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Mindset: Client-focused, proactive, and solution-oriented with a passion for defense strategy and impactful narratives.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact defense sector projects with global clients.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and dynamic work environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements and a strong focus on professional growth.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

What is it like to work at Infomineo?

If you've spoken with someone who works at Infomineo, you've probably heard that our people are our most valuable asset. Our diversity, both in terms of professional experience and culture, is the company’s greatest strength.

By being a part of Infomineo, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a friendly, smart, and international team of researchers that value intellectual vitality and creativity. You will learn the best practices, tools to use when conducting primary and secondary research. You will grow your career, expertise across different regions and industries. As a member of the team, you'll be encouraged to contribute by applying your ideas while playing an instrumental role in the company’s development and growth. Within this role, you'll support leading international institutions & companies with the data and information required to fuel key business decisions.

title: GIS Analyst
description:
Job opportunity
The Corporation of the Town of Orangeville invites applications for the position of
GIS Analyst
Corporate Services department
(twelve-month contract position, 35 hours per week)
Located on the north-west edge of the Greater Toronto Area, less than one hour’s drive from Toronto and yet only moments away from the unspoiled, natural beauty of the Niagara Escarpment, the Town of Orangeville (“Town”) offers an excellent combination of location, small town charm and urban amenities. Situated in the picturesque natural setting of the Hills of Headwaters, Orangeville is home to over 30,000 residents and is the largest urban community and regional service centre within the County of Dufferin. Orangeville is a great place to raise a family, with an excellent quality of life and a strong sense of community. The Town is committed to a value based, thriving and collaborative work environment that supports our employees’ success. Our employees are passionate about delivering high-quality programs and services to our residents and are proud to contribute to making Orangeville one of the exceptional places to live in Canada.
The Corporate Services Department has a contract opportunity available, for a Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Analyst position. This is a 12-month contract opportunity, beginning November 2026 and end November 2027.
Position description
This position supports the Town’s GIS initiatives by managing and analyzing spatial data, supporting enterprise GIS applications, and collaborating with various teams to deliver innovative geospatial solutions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and needs. This role focuses on maintaining and enhancing GIS-based applications, including the Town’s Citywide enterprise application. Additionally, the GIS Analyst will serve as a system and application administrator for enterprise applications, ensuring seamless integration, performance optimization, and end user support.
Job duties

Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and data visualization tools for GIS and non-GIS datasets to support decision-making, awareness, and reporting needs; designing and implementing GIS solutions that enhance decision-making and operational efficiency; supporting enterprise GIS applications and systems to ensure reliability and performance, troubleshooting as needed; and creating automation tools and workflows to optimize processes and enhance geospatial solutions.
Updating, maintaining, and analyzing spatial data within the GIS platform, ensuring data quality and accuracy; collaborating with staff to gather spatial data requirements and perform normalization and validation; processing and integrating datasets from diverse sources, such as mobile devices, aerial imagery, databases, and hardcopy formats; working with the team to improve and maintain open data initiatives, promoting its adoption across departments.
Providing user support and training on GIS tools, solutions, and applications; administration and backend configuration of GIS systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise applications; and collaborating on cross-functional projects to align GIS solutions with broader organizational goals.
Maintaining documentation, including workflows, metadata, and training materials, for GIS and enterprise applications; developing user guides and providing training sessions for staff to enhance GIS tool adoption and proficiency; and supporting ad hoc GIS tasks and projects as required to meet organizational goals.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

University degree specializing in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geomatics, Geography, Urban Planning, or a related field; or a combination of education, training, and experience deemed to be equivalent.

Minimum four (4) years of progressive work experience in GIS analysis, application support, and solution development.

Demonstrated practical experience with GIS technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Mobile, 3D Analyst, ArcSDE, Spatial Analyst, Model Builder, and Geocortex.
Proven experience working with spatial databases (e.g., ArcSDE, SQL Server) and performing GIS data management, analysis, and integration.
Experience in GIS solution design and implementation, including installation, configuration, and administration of GIS applications.
Hands-on experience supporting and maintaining enterprise applications with GIS components, such as Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) or work order systems, ensuring seamless integration and optimization for business needs. Experience in system and application administration for enterprise applications is highly desirable.
Experience developing GIS solutions, dashboards, web applications, or automation tools (e.g., Python scripts, FME workflows) to enhance organizational processes and improve data visualization and operational insights, and skilled in integrating GIS with applications such as Citywide, Command Center, Great Plains, and SharePoint, with a focus on ensuring seamless synchronization of GIS data components.
Proficiency in GIS principles, spatial data governance, and geodatabase management, knowledge of GIS methods, cartography, coordinate systems, projections, and geospatial analysis techniques.
Competency in scripting and ETL tools such as Python, FME, or ModelBuilder, and familiarity with GIS-based web technologies (e.g., JavaScript APIs, ArcGIS Web AppBuilder).
Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to shifting priorities.
Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
Familiarity with enterprise application support, including system implementation, upgrades, and cross-system integrations for enterprise asset management (EAM) and work-order systems, as well as other related platforms.

Successful candidates will be required to complete a background check, including but not limited to a Criminal Record Check, in accordance with the duties of this position.

Applications may be submitted online, at orangeville.ca/jobs or in person at Town Hall on 87 Broadway, addressed to Human Resources. Please do not email your application. title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
This is Hybrid role (3 days in office /2 days remote)
About your Team:
The Enterprise Architecture organization is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the team and help build the next generation of data infrastructure and AI-enabled workflows. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the scalable data lake platform, cloud infrastructure, and self-service tooling that internal teams across IBKR rely on to ingest, govern, and analyze data at scale. You will partner closely with internal development teams and IT leadership to architect platform solutions for diverse use cases across the organization, ranging from cloud-native data lakes and infrastructure as code to AI knowledge bases and advanced analytics. Your work will focus on delivering robust, well-documented data platform capabilities and establishing best practices for data engineering and platform operations across the enterprise.

What will be your responsibilities within IBKR:

Design, build, and operate the data lake platform and infrastructure, including S3-based storage and the AWS Glue data catalog, delivered as a governed, self-service platform that internal teams can build on
Design and implement data governance and fine-grained access control across the platform using AWS Lake Formation, ensuring secure, least-privilege, and compliant access to data domains
Automate infrastructure provisioning as code (e.g., Terraform), giving internal teams a repeatable, self-service path to stand up new platform resources
Contribute to the GenAI knowledge base platform and Python-based services that internal teams use to build retrieval-augmented (RAG) and knowledge-driven AI applications
Build or contribute to real-time streaming data pipelines (e.g., using Kafka) for event-driven analytics and data processing, as platform needs evolve
Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data crawlers to ingest data from various sources, transforming structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (text, images, audio, video) for analytics and AI/ML workloads

Relaxed Dress Code: Your authentic self is always in style at Caleres
Site Perks: Full access to our brand new downtown Clayton, MO office, including, onsite gym, Starbucks, Grab and Go Market, beautiful indoor/outdoor meeting spaces and free parking located in the convenient area of downtown Clayton, MO.

Qualifications That Make You the Perfect Fit!

Associate's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred; equivalent work experience considered
0-2 years of collections, accounts receivable, customer service, administrative, or related business experience

They typically list expectations instead of specific tasks and are to be used only as parameters and guidelines. A competency’s description is not intended to exclusively define every KSA, task, and behavior needed to meet the competency successfully but rather to provide the manager/agency with a broad reference of options as to how an applicant can meet the job expectation.

Please ensure your application (through work history, training, education, licenses, certifications, etc.) supports/demonstrates you possess the minimum required competencies for the job class.

Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with competencies in

Any combination of preparatory post-secondary education and/or experience providing administrative support to a business or organization, business administration, public administration, finance, banking, accounting, industrial relations, marketing, human resource management, logistics and supply chain management, or a similar business field.

title: Freight & Logistics Planner
description:
The Freight & Logistics Planner is responsible for keeping shipments moving at the best cost and service level. The role analyzes freight spend, carrier performance and shipping patterns. It turns those findings into recommendations on routing, mode selection, carrier sourcing and cost reduction, and works closely with carriers, warehouse teams, procurement and finance.

The Freight and Logistics Planner plays an integral role in our Customer Experience and ensures our Customers receive exceptional service throughout the flow of order processing, as well as ensuring problems with order flow are expertly resolved.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with Tayco’s motivated and engaging team, enjoy Tayco’s fantastic culture which has won us our Great Place to Work certification, as well as be an important part of our exciting growth plans.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Responsibilities:

  • Load planning and scheduling: Plan inbound and outbound shipments and build loads that make the best use of trailer and container space.
  • Carrier booking: Tender loads to contracted carriers or brokers, choose the right mode (FTL, LTL, intermodal, or air) and confirm capacity.
  • Shipment tracking: Monitor freight in transit and give customers and internal teams proactive updates on delays or exceptions. Work with CER and Scheduling when customer has a must arrive date.
  • Issue resolution: Handle missed pickups, delays, damages, refused deliveries and re-routing, and file claims when needed. Minimize freight claims and work with the freight partners to find the root cause. File freight claims on time with all freight carriers.
  • Documentation: Prepare and check bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices and customs paperwork. Coordinate with customs brokers on cross-border shipments.
  • Warehouse coordination: Line up dock schedules, staffing needs and order readiness with the warehouse so loads ship on time.
  • Cost control: Choose cost-effective routes and carriers, consolidate shipments where possible and keep accessorial charges (detention, redelivery, storage) to a minimum. Reduce freight cost on an ongoing basis established in the business plan, annualized savings on the freight costs (Gross sales v/s freight costs).
  • Systems: Keep shipment data, rates and appointments accurate in the ERP.
  • Performance tracking: Report on carrier on-time performance, OTIF and shipping costs, and suggest process improvements.
  • Compliance: Make sure shipments follow DOT and Transport Canada rules, hours-of-service limits, dangerous goods/hazmat rules and customs regulations.
  • Sourcing and qualification: Find new carriers and service providers when you need more capacity, new lanes or backup options. Collect carrier profiles covering equipment types, service areas, fleet size, specialties (reefer, flatbed, hazmat, cross-border) and references. Screen carriers against company criteria such as years in business, safety record, financial stability and capacity.

title: Behavioural - RPN
description:
“How do you live in the moment?”


We are passionate about ‘Making Every Moment Matter’™. We are seeking a candidate that shares our values - a person who has a passion to make a difference, who has a strong moral compass, and who has a commitment to teamwork. The ideal candidate is a warm and loving person who makes meaningful connections with those they are caring for.


The Behaviour Support- RPN reports to the Director of Care and is a role responsible for leading the Home’s Responsive Behaviours Program and practice support to promote resident safety, dignity, and quality of life. The Behaviour Support- RPN provides specialized clinical leadership for older adults who present with, or are at risk for, responsive behaviours/personal expressions related to dementia, complex mental health,substance use, and/or other neurological conditions, ensuring approaches are person-centered, least restrictive, and aligned with Ontario long-term care legislative and regulatory requirements. Working collaboratively with residents and families/SDMs, the interdisciplinary team, and external partners, the Behaviour Support- RPN coordinates comprehensive assessment and individualized behaviour support planning, coaching staff in prevention, de-escalation, and safe care strategies. The role builds strong partnerships with Behavioural Supports Ontario (BSO) resources and other regional/community supports (e.g., psychogeriatric and geriatric mental health outreach, hospitals, Ontario Health at Home, primary care providers) to strengthen transitions, consultation, and continuity of care.


Wage Rate:
The starting wage rate is $32.09 /hour.

Vacancy:
This is an existing vacancy.

Responsibilities:
● Lead the Home’s Expression of Needs Program as a required, ensuring written approaches to care are in place (screening protocols, assessment/reassessment, and
identification of behavioural triggers) and embedded into daily practice.
● Establish and maintain program processes for monitoring, internal reporting, documentation, referrals to specialized resources, and ongoing evaluation.
● Provide leadership to related required programs and high-risk clinical processes (e.g., restraint minimization/least-restrictive approaches, falls prevention supports).
● Provide comprehensive assessments and consultation for residents with, or at risk for, expression of needs related to dementia, delirium, mental health, substance use, and neurological conditions.
● Coach teams to use structured frameworks (e.g., P.I.E.C.E.S., U-First, ABC approaches) to identify triggers, unmet needs, and prevention strategies, and to develop individualized behaviour support plans and care plan interventions.
● Participate in, and support, interdisciplinary care conferences with residents/families/SDMs to align expression of needs approaches with resident goals,
preferences, rights, and dignity.
● Assist in initiatives that promote safe, appropriate medication use for expression of needs (including antipsychotic stewardship), partnering with physicians/NP and pharmacy to identify residents for review and implement non-pharmacological strategies with monitoring and follow-up.
● Provide day-to-day coaching, mentoring, and just-in-time support to build staff confidence in prevention, de-escalation, and safe care approaches—reinforcing consistent
practice across shifts.
● Participate in the hiring process of registered staff and PSWs and monitor performance and follow through with the progressive disciplinary process.
● Identify training needs and coordinate ongoing capacity building with Behavioural Supports Ontario resources and other outreach partners.
● Contribute to onboarding/orientation for new staff, caregivers, agency staff, students, and volunteers regarding the Home’s Expression of Needs Program and safe response expectations.
● Collaborate with external partners (e.g., BSO resources, psychogeriatric/geriatric mental health outreach, hospitals, Ontario Health at Home) to coordinate consultation, referrals, and continuity of behaviour supports across care settings.
● Support safe transitions (admission, return from hospital, unit changes) for residents with Expression of Needs by ensuring plan of plans and risk supports are current and
communicated to the care team.
● Support the Home’s workplace violence prevention efforts by helping identify and mitigate risks related to expression of needs, reinforcing reporting processes, and participating in debriefs/action planning following incidents aligned with OHSA workplace violence requirements.
● Integrate IPAC expectations into needs support planning and care (e.g., hand hygiene/PPE/PCRA considerations during close-contact interventions) and coordinate
with IPAC leadership to adapt approaches during outbreaks or additional precautions.
● Apply culturally safe and appropriate approaches in assessment, communication, and care planning, consistent with professional practice expectations.
● Monitor trends (e.g., triggers, escalation patterns, incident themes, medication-related outcomes, use of safety measures) and translate findings into targeted improvement actions, education, and practice supports.
● Prepare clear summaries and reports for leadership/committees (as assigned) to support compliance readiness and quality decision-making.
● Support accreditation readiness (CARF, where applicable) by maintaining evidence of program processes, outcomes monitoring, and continuous improvement actions.
● Participate in interdisciplinary care conferences with residents and families/SDMs and the care team to identify, plan for, and evaluate supports for the resident’s expression of needs, ensuring approaches are resident-centred and clearly documented.
● Support safe and coordinated transitions for residents with expression of needs (new or existing) between the community, hospital, and neighbouring long-term care homes by ensuring needs support plans, risks, and successful strategies are communicated and followed.
● Convene and chair regular Behaviour Rounds that enable front-line staff to discuss care plans with internal and external resources.
● Advocate for and protect resident rights, dignity, and choice, promoting least-restrictive, culturally safe approaches to care.
● Escalate resident-specific barriers and recurring challenges to the Director of Care/leadership to identify systemic issues and support broader consultation, resource
allocation, and improvement planning.
● Proactively identify education and training needs related to expression of needs and coordinate with Psychogeriatric Resource Consultants (PRCs) and other partners to
deliver capacity-building supports.
● Contribute to orientation and onboarding for new staff, volunteers, students, and agency staff related to the Home’s Expression of Needs program’s expectations and safe
response practices.
● Use digital tools (including AI-enabled features where available) to support documentation, trend monitoring, and education planning related to responsive behaviours, while ensuring clinical judgment and person-centered decision-making remain primary.
● Other duties as assigned and or indicated in Job Task Inventory

Qualifications:
The qualifications needed to join our family are as follows:
● RPN/RN with advanced dementia/mental health/behavioural practice experience and strong coaching/leadership skills.
● Current registration with the appropriate College registered with a regulatory authority ina Canadian jurisdiction, other than Ontario, and holds in that jurisdiction the equivalent of a certificate of registration authorizing independent practice in Ontario as of right exemption Bill 60,
● Strong knowledge and experience supporting residents with responsive behaviours/personal expressions related to dementia, delirium, complex mental health,
substance use, and/or neurological conditions, including assessment, trigger identification, and individualized approaches to care.
● Working knowledge of regulatory requirements and the ability to operationalize the Home’s Responsive Behaviours Program. Current training or competence in recognized responsive behaviour frameworks and approaches such as Gentle Persuasive Approaches (GPA) and P.I.E.C.E.S. and/or U-First! (or commitment to obtain within a defined timeframe); Montessori/DementiAbility methods are strong assets.
● Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to coach teams, support practice change, and contribute to performance improvement processes. (Supervisory/managerial experience is a strong asset.)
● Proficiency with electronic documentation and care planning; experience with interRAI, CAPs, and behaviour/care plan documentation is an asset.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills and proven ability to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and external partners (BSO resources, psychogeriatric/geriatric mental health outreach, hospitals, Ontario Health at Home).
● Demonstrated commitment to person- and family-centered, culturally safe and appropriate approaches that preserve dignity, autonomy, and least-restrictive care.
● Knowledge of privacy/confidentiality requirements (PHIPA concepts) and the ability to manage sensitive information appropriately.
● Experience leading quality improvement initiatives and using indicators/audits to reduce responsive behaviour risk and improve resident outcomes.

● Current CPR/First Aid certification
● Minimum one (1) year experience with clients in long-term care or residents in a long term care home setting

● Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Word and Excel, online learning platforms, and electronic communication tools (email, mobile devices), with the ability to
document, track, and report information electronically as required.
● Demonstrate flexibility in schedule to ensure all shifts (Days, Evenings, and Nights) get support if needed
● To show evidence of being focused on people’s feelings when interacting and knowing how to turn a task into positive social interaction.
● To undertake and meet all legal requirements within a context of promoting individuals’ rights and measuring/reducing elements of risk.

(within the last year), as per Public Health requirements
● Two supervisory references required
● Provide proof of all required vaccines. The Employer strongly recommends to “stay up to date” with the recommended vaccines. Vaccination requirements are subject to changes as determined by the Employer

title: Data Architect
description:
About Signant Health
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health, you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
About the Role
The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture and strategy that brings data from Signant Health's diverse operational systems into Snowflake, our primary enterprise data platform. As an individual contributor reporting to the Head of AI, this role combines strategic architectural thinking with hands-on data engineering — building the frameworks and reference pipelines that engineering teams adopt and scale. This is an opportunity to break down data silos, reduce redundant integrations, and enable data-driven decision making and AI across the organization.
Key Accountabilities
Data Architecture & Strategy

Define and maintain the target-state enterprise data architecture and multi-year roadmap, with Snowflake as the central data platform.
Document the current-state data landscape across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, and enterprise SaaS applications; perform gap analysis and develop a prioritized onboarding roadmap.
Establish architectural principles, reference architectures, and standard patterns for data ingestion, storage, transformation, and consumption; evaluate and recommend tooling via build-vs.-buy analysis.

Data Integration & Engineering

Design and build ingestion patterns — CDC, batch, streaming, and API-based — using AWS-native and Snowflake-native services (AWS DMS, Glue, Kinesis/MSK, Snowpipe, dbt) and establish engineering standards for pipelines, CI/CD, observability, and error handling.
Develop source-to-target reconciliation and validation frameworks consistent with ALCOA+ data integrity principles; optimize Snowflake performance and cost as data volumes grow.

Data Modeling & Master Data

Design enterprise and canonical data models and a layered Snowflake architecture (raw, conformed, and curated/medallion layers), including conformed business entities shared across products.
Establish master and reference data management approaches; guide selection of dimensional, Data Vault, or other modeling techniques appropriate to each use case.

Data Governance, Quality & Compliance

Define the enterprise data governance framework including ownership, stewardship, data contracts, quality monitoring, metadata management, and end-to-end data lineage.
Design data protection controls (classification, RBAC, masking, tokenization of PII/PHI) and ensure the architecture supports GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 requirements.

Analytics, AI & Technical Leadership

Partner with BI, analytics, and AI teams to deliver curated data products for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI/ML use cases including RAG pipelines and Snowflake Cortex AI.
Lead cross-team architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and serve as the primary technical liaison with Snowflake and other data platform vendors.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes
Required

10+ years in data engineering or software engineering, including 5+ years in data architecture and 3+ years delivering production Snowflake solutions.
Deep experience integrating heterogeneous sources (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, enterprise SaaS); expert SQL and data modeling skills; proficiency in Python and dbt.
Proven AWS experience (S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, IAM); experience with orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code (Airflow, Terraform, Git).
Experience designing governance, security, and compliance controls for regulated data; ability to produce architecture artifacts and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

Experience in pharmaceutical, clinical research, or another regulated industry (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, GAMP 5); familiarity with CDISC SDTM/ODM or HL7 FHIR.
Advanced Snowflake experience (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Iceberg, Cortex AI, Secure Data Sharing); experience with AI/ML enablement, data catalog/observability tools, or data mesh patterns.
SnowPro Advanced certification; AWS data or solutions architecture certifications a plus.

Why Signant Health?
At Signant Health, your work has real impact — helping advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster. We offer a collaborative, global environment with opportunities to take ownership, drive meaningful innovation, and work alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations. If you are looking for purpose-driven work and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. title: Senior Stormwater Management Engineer
description:
Here’s your chance to contribute to meaningful work that helps improve community infrastructure, protect the environment, and support municipalities in making informed, sustainable engineering decisions. As a Senior Stormwater Management Engineer, you’ll bring your technical expertise, leadership abilities, and strong analytical mindset to projects that shape resilient communities across Southern Ontario.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values initiative, curiosity, and follow-through. Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading and managing stormwater management and water resources projects, including stormwater and sewer design for road reconstruction projects, drainage studies, floodplain studies, watershed assessments, and stormwater facility retrofits.
  • Conducting peer reviews of subdivision and site plan applications to ensure compliance with municipal standards, guidelines, and sound engineering practices.
  • Supporting business development through proposal preparation, client engagement, and participation in annual planning efforts.
  • Mentoring and developing water resources engineers and technical staff across multiple offices.

What You Bring

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems and takes pride in delivering high‑quality work. You’ll succeed if you have:

  • A degree in Civil, Environmental, or Water Resources Engineering and a P.Eng. designation.
  • 10+ years of experience in stormwater management, water resources engineering, municipal infrastructure, or land development.
  • Strong technical expertise with modelling tools such as PCSWMM, Visual OTTHYMO, SWMHYMO, InfoWorks, and HEC‑RAS (1D and 2D).
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, colleagues, and approval agencies.
  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D.
  • Familiarity with subdivision and site plan approval processes, or prior peer review experience.
  • Formal project management training (e.g., PMP) or experience overseeing construction on behalf of municipalities.

Salary Range: $130,000 - $155,000

The final compensation offered will be based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and market conditions.

Position Type: Vacancy

Why Choose Burnside?

Are you interested in working for an employer with a 5-decade track record of building a great reputation both internally with their staff and externally with their clients? The Burnside team is a supportive group of colleagues that work together to provide value and service to our clients, while extending care to each other. We know that our employees are our greatest asset, and thus we strive to provide a positive work/life balance.

We offer:

  • A collaborative culture where friendship, honesty and respect are part of our core values and practices
  • Flexible working hours, including hybrid working opportunities
